title: Library Loans (repository warm-up)
src: Written for this mock · repository warm-up
body:
You are given the repository of a small library loans API: it lists the books, lends them to members and takes them back, charging a fee when a book comes back late.

Issue: the librarians report that members can take out more books than the rules allow, and that books returned on time are being charged a late fee. 2 integrated test cases fail.

Run the tests, read the failures, find the component each one points to, fix it, and run the tests again until they pass. The lending rules are in README.md.

Note: the acceptance criteria are the predefined tests; more tests run when you submit.

Written for this mock as a warm-up for the repository tasks (it isn't from a company OA). The code is small on purpose: about ten files and two bugs, so the whole loop of a repository question takes 15 to 30 minutes.
